themes.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — light register, #ffffff pageBackground, #df5e12 orange accent, #1e3a35 dark teal hero
All proprietary fonts replaced: Space Grotesk (body/button), Syncopate (display/links, -0.04em tracking), Barlow Condensed. Display at clamp(64px, 8vw, 120px), weight 700.

Holographic overlay applied: 5 new keyframes (holoShift, shimmerSweep, rainbowShift, prismaticReveal, chromaFlicker). Easings renamed prismEase/foilEase/shimmerEase. Durations: holoShift 8s, rainbowCycle 4s, prismatic 12s.
16-column micro-grid overlay added at 7% opacity, mix-blend-mode: overlay, pointer-events: none. 1520px container. Primary 12-col grid unchanged.
foil-gap 1px hairline token added. Section marginTop/Bottom 269px. Container borderRadius 22px, panel 12px.

Holographic chromatic interactions: hover = scale(1.02) + hue-rotate(20deg) saturate(1.4); active = scale(0.98) + hue-rotate(40deg) brightness(1.1); cards hover = translateY(-3px) + hue-rotate(15deg); inputs focus = 5-stop rainbow box-shadow.

Iridescent rainbow border-bottom on scroll via animated gradient. Nav scrolled: backdrop-filter blur(18px) saturate(1.6). Links hover: hue-rotate(120deg) brightness(1.1). Font fixed: Inter → inherit (Space Grotesk not in typography set).

Full holographic override. concept_by_image.md: prismatic surface refraction, chromatic aberration as signal, foil-gap hairlines, rainbow spectral shift. concept_by_video.md: 3 video placements — holo-surface.mp4 (hero 8s), prism-refraction.mp4 (features 6s), iridescent-bubble.mp4 (editorial 10s).

consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: FIXED — Inter not in type system, replaced with inherit
